title: Add Router extension API for one-line telemetry mounting
description: Provide an Actix-like ergonomic API by adding Router::with_telemetry() and Router::with_telemetry_layer(...), then update docs/examples to lead with this flow.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Add RouterTelemetryExt with with_telemetry() and with_telemetry_layer(...); 2) Keep TelemetryLayer::default() and TelemetryLayer::builder() supported; 3) Update README quickstart to use .with_telemetry(); 4) Add tests validating extension trait behavior; 5) Preserve existing reqwest e2e coverage and keep all checks green
notes:
Implementation checklist:
- Add extension trait and export it from lib.rs
- Provide default zero-config mount path
- Keep advanced customization path with TelemetryLayer::builder()
- Update docs and examples to lead with the one-liner API
- Run cargo fmt, clippy -D warnings, and full test suite
Implemented RouterTelemetryExt with with_telemetry() and with_telemetry_layer(...), introduced TelemetryLayer::default()/builder(), updated main + README + AGENTS guidance, and added router extension tests. Validation: cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo test.
